schema_documentation:
All 20 keys on 100% of records (single key-set, 411/411 in stats). Values are `str` or JSON `null`; no dicts/lists. Non-empty rates from my stratified sample (first 200 records of each of 7 shards, n=1,400 = 15.1%).

| key | type | non-empty | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | str | 100.0% | full PDF-extracted thesis body; embedded HTML tables + `![…](page_*.png)` figure refs |
| `title` | str/null | 98.6% | Greek title, may contain `\r\n` |
| `abstract` | str/null | 77.1% | Greek abstract (clean metadata), contains `\r\n` |
| `author` | str/null | 98.1% | "Επώνυμο, Όνομα" |
| `advisor` | str/null | 97.2% | supervisor; sometimes the placeholder "Δε διατίθεται" |
| `committee_members` | str/null | 98.4% | committee. The placeholder "Δεν/Δε διατίθεται" is only 387 of 9,021 non-empty values (4.3%) over ALL 9,262 records — it clusters at the start of shard 0, which is why head-sampling reports ~46%. `advisor` carries it in 141 records. |
| `alt_title` | str/null | 20.4% | English title |
| `keywords` | str/null | 99.8% | ` ; `-joined subject keywords |
| `classification` | str/null | 1.6% | LC-style subject — unusable |
| `type` | str/null | 100.0% | Μεταπτυχιακή εργασία 1238 / Προπτυχιακή–Διπλωματική 115 / Διδακτορική διατριβή 46 / "Μεταπτυχιακή  εργασία" 1 (double space) per 1,400 |
| `publication_date` | str | 100.0% | "YYYY" or "YYYY-MM-DD" |
| `path` | str | 100.0% | ` > `-joined DSpace tree path |
| `institution` | str/null | 99.1% | department/section (Τμήμα Ιατρικής 321/1400 = 23%) |
| `record_provider` | str/null | 98.5% | full "Δημοκρίτειο Πανεπιστήμιο Θράκης. Σχολή … Τμήμα …" |
| `description` | str/null | 94.8% | short descriptor (mean 26 chars) |
| `master_program` | str/null | 0.4% | unusable |
| `license` | str/null | 85.3% | CC name; 5+ malformed values "An error occurred on the license name." |
| `license_url` | str/null | 85.3% | CC URL |
| `url` | str | 100.0% | https://repo.lib.duth.gr/jspui/handle/… (1,400/1,400) |
